test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 1 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

The manager / did not / gone to / Bombay yesterday.
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: **gone to**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Replace "gone" with "go" to correct the sentence.
 
• Gone is the third form of the verb "**Go**"
 
• The given sentence is written in simple past tense and in negative form.
 
• The structure should be: Subject + didnot+ v1+ object__
 
 
• **Example -** *I didn't want this to happen.*
 
 
 
• So, the first form of the verb "go" should be used here.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 1, which contains an error in it.

Corrected sentence: *The manager did not go to Bombay yesterday.*
